Threshold Help
fields.options: Boundaries are read according to the metric's direction. higher_is_better: Green when value ≥ Green Boundary, Amber when value ≥ Amber Boundary, otherwise Red. lower_is_better: Green when value ≤ Green Boundary, Amber when value ≤ Amber Boundary, otherwise Red. neutral metrics are never graded. Leaving all three at 0 means "not configured": the shipped default applies, and where there is no shipped default the status is Unknown. A boundary of 0 counts as a real bound only for Count metrics.
